references.comment: Null reference if github_authenticated_user state is missing
OAuth state uses pipeline.signature (static) instead of a per-request random value

The code attempts to access integration.metadata[sender][login] without checking for the existence of the sender key. This causes a KeyError for integrations where the sender metadata was not set during creation

rows.label: match
rows.reason: Both identify that pipeline.signature is used as the OAuth state parameter instead of a per-request random value, describing the same concrete security weakness in OAuthLoginView.dispatch.

rows.label: uncertain
rows.reason: The inconsistent dual-query logic is a real code smell but no reference specifically identifies this as a concrete failure mode; the behavior difference (inactive integration) is real but not clearly a bug given the flow.

rows.label: match
rows.reason: Both identify the exact same KeyError risk when accessing integration.metadata['sender']['login'] without checking for the 'sender' key's existence, at the same location in GitHubInstallation.dispatch.
